beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: New York makes time itself operational: calendar authority, dispersed venues, capture, broadcast, production labor, orders and memory must coordinate. This chapter follows commerce: Between runway attention and an order sit identifiers, line sheets, showrooms, buyer permissions and product records whose adoption is often claimed faster than it is proved.
beats.onScreen: Then: CFDA says its Fashion Manufacturing Initiative began with NYCEDC in 2013 to support New York City fashion manufacturing.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: CFDA says its Fashion Manufacturing Initiative began with NYCEDC in 2013 to support New York City fashion manufacturing. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: CFDA’s current open Production Directory lists more than 380 U.S. manufacturers, while its Materials Hub connects users to material innovators, vendors and resources.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: Neither directory proves which supplier, ordering or wholesale system a September 2026 collection actually uses; those links require brand-level reporting.
